intro: CAVA Classic Lemonade (22 oz) delivers refreshing citrus flavor made from freshly squeezed lemon juice and cane sugar. This larger drink size perfectly complements any meal from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks). At 360 calories, it provides a sweet, tangy beverage option to balance the Mediterranean flavors found throughout the [full CAVA menu](/). Ideal for guests seeking a traditional lemonade experience.
priceCalories: Priced at $3.85 for the 22 oz size, CAVA Classic Lemonade contains 360 calories with 95g of carbohydrates and zero protein or fat. The drink uses simple, quality ingredients without artificial sweeteners or preservatives. This larger portion offers better value for guests wanting more refreshment with their [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) selections or pita wraps.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets CAVA Classic Lemonade apart is its commitment to freshly squeezed lemon juice rather than concentrate. The combination of real lemons and pure cane sugar creates authentic lemonade flavor. Each 22 oz serving provides substantial refreshment without artificial ingredients. This traditional approach reflects CAVA's dedication to quality across their beverage selection and entire menu.
nutritionFacts: Each 22 oz Classic Lemonade contains 360 calories derived entirely from 95g of carbohydrates, primarily natural sugars from cane sugar and lemon juice. The drink contains 0g protein and 0g fat, making it a pure carbohydrate beverage. With no artificial sweeteners or additives, it offers straightforward nutrition information. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) for detailed dietary data.
whatsInside: CAVA Classic Lemonade features just three simple ingredients: freshly squeezed lemon juice, cane sugar, and water. The absence of artificial flavors, colors, or preservatives keeps the ingredient list clean and transparent. Real lemon juice provides natural vitamin C and authentic citrus flavor. This minimalist approach aligns with CAVA's commitment to quality ingredients throughout their menu.
tasteLike: CAVA Classic Lemonade tastes like traditional homemade lemonade with bright, tart lemon flavor balanced by sweet cane sugar. The freshly squeezed juice provides authentic citrus notes without artificial aftertaste. Each sip delivers refreshing tanginess with smooth sweetness. The 22 oz size maintains consistent flavor throughout, offering a classic lemonade experience that complements Mediterranean cuisine perfectly.
customize: Classic Lemonade comes as a prepared beverage without customization options, ensuring consistent quality and flavor. Guests can choose between 16 oz and 22 oz sizes based on their thirst level and value preference. The drink pairs naturally with any selections from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) or [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) without requiring modifications or adjustments.
pairsWell: This refreshing lemonade pairs excellently with rich, savory dishes like Spicy Lamb Meatballs or Grilled Chicken from CAVA's protein options. The citrus acidity cuts through creamy dips like Crazy Feta or Hummus. It also complements Mediterranean spices found in falafel and roasted vegetables. The sweet-tart profile balances bold flavors throughout CAVA's menu, making it a versatile beverage choice.
healthyChoice: While Classic Lemonade offers real ingredients without artificial additives, its 95g of carbohydrates and 360 calories make it a higher-calorie beverage option. The drink contains natural sugars from cane sugar rather than high-fructose corn syrup. For lower-calorie alternatives, consider the 16 oz Classic Lemonade at 260 calories or explore options on the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks).
howToOrder: Order CAVA Classic Lemonade (22 oz) at the beverage station when building your bowl or pita. Simply request the larger 22 oz size if you want more refreshment than the 16 oz option. The drink comes pre-made and ready to enjoy. Available at all CAVA locations alongside other beverage choices. Check [CAVA Locations](/locations) to find your nearest restaurant.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the 16 oz Classic Lemonade (260 cal, $3.45), the 22 oz provides 100 additional calories for just 40 cents more. Blueberry Lavender Lemonade offers unique flavor at 190 calories for 22 oz, while Cucumber Mint Lime provides 180 calories in 16 oz. Classic Lemonade delivers traditional taste without experimental flavors, appealing to guests preferring straightforward refreshment.
whoShouldTry: Classic Lemonade suits guests who enjoy traditional lemonade flavor with meals. Families appreciate the familiar taste that appeals to all ages. Those seeking real ingredients without artificial sweeteners will value the simple recipe. Anyone building bowls or pitas who wants citrus refreshment should consider this beverage. It works well for guests wanting a sweet drink to balance savory Mediterranean flavors.
worthTrying: CAVA Classic Lemonade (22 oz) is worth trying for its commitment to freshly squeezed lemon juice and simple ingredients. At $3.85, it provides good value for a larger beverage made without shortcuts or artificial components. The authentic lemonade flavor enhances the Mediterranean dining experience. While higher in calories, it delivers genuine taste that complements CAVA's food offerings perfectly.
